Subject: SIG — subprocessor/third-party vendor list request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our InfoSec team is running through the SIG questionnaire and has a couple of follow-ups. The primary one right now is the subprocessor inventory — specifically we need a vendor list that covers: cloud providers (compute/storage), observability/telemetry, support/helpdesk tooling, error monitoring, and any third parties that process telemetry or usage data.

Can you send a current vendor inventory (name, service provided, data types processed, country of processing, and whether there is a DPA in place) for inclusion in our SIG spreadsheet? If you already have a CSV or a short doc, that would be ideal.

Also, if there are known vendors that handle customer logs or chat transcripts (even for debugging), please flag those — we treat those differently.

Timeline: can you get this to us by Thursday EOD PT? Our security reviewers want to close the SIG this week.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Jenna Park
Security Operations
FintechCo

Marissa / team / Jenna — attaching the vendor inventory as requested. Notes below; see CSV for per-vendor columns.

Attachments:
- redwood_subprocessors_2026-02.csv (attachment stub)
- SIG_answer_sheet_v1.pdf (attachment stub; partial answers to SIG rows related to third parties)

Summary highlights:
- Cloud: Primary compute + storage = AWS (us-west-2) — EC2/EBS/S3. We use encrypted buckets; customer data-at-rest is encrypted with AWS KMS. DPA in place via Master Services Agreement and Data Processing Addendum.
- Observability/Telemetry: Datadog (aggregated metrics + service traces), Sentry (error + exception telemetry). Both receive anonymized application-level telemetry; no customer PII intentionally sent. For customers who enable debug mode or explicitly share logs, traces may contain snippets — these are controlled.
- Support tooling: Zendesk (ticketing) and Intercom (optional chat for managed customers). Customer-submitted support transcripts are stored in Zendesk; Intercom is used only when customers opt in to chat.
- Model infra/feature flags: LaunchDarkly (feature flags, no PII), HashiCorp Vault (secrets), PostHog (product analytics) — PostHog used for product usage telemetry; customers can opt out via account settings.
- Payment/BI: Stripe (billing metadata — no raw transcripts) and Looker (BI).

Access & retention notes:
- Default telemetry retention: 90 days for traces/metrics; aggregated metrics retained longer for platform health (1 year).
- Support transcripts retained per customer settings; we can apply retention policies if required by contract.
- Where third parties process data outside the US, we indicate country in the CSV and the DPA status.

Legal & compliance pointers:
- SOC 2: We have a current SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood Inference SOC2 2025) — we can provide under NDA.
- DPAs: standard DPA executed with cloud providers and primary vendors; we'll surface copies where required by procurement.

Jenna — if you need a pivot table or an alternate CSV format for your SIG spreadsheet, tell us which columns you need and we can re-export.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1-650-555-0199

Marissa / Vivek — thanks for the fast turnaround and the CSV + PDF. I reviewed the file quickly and two quick clarifications before we close the SIG:

1) Telemetry detail: you list Datadog and Sentry — can you confirm whether either vendor receives raw chat transcripts or unredacted request payloads? For example, when debugging a customer API call that includes user-provided text, are those payloads sent to Sentry/Datadog?

2) Retention flexibility: we need to know whether retention windows for traces/logs can be shortened per-customer (e.g., 30 days) and if that requires a paid plan or specific contract clause.

If you can answer those two points and re-send a one-page summary, we can mark the SIG row as closed.

Thanks again — if it's easier for you to give a short phone call, I'm available Fri morning PT.

Best,
Jenna
Security Operations
FintechCo
